name: Burghotel Alpenglühn
beschreibung: The Burghotel Alpenglühn is located in Obergurgl, a high-altitude village in the Ötztal valley. The castle-inspired architecture blends harmoniously into the alpine landscape. The guest rooms are decorated in a modern alpine style, and great emphasis is placed on regional culinary delights. The wellness area features soothing saunas and pool facilities. Obergurgl is renowned for its snow-sure ski slopes and extensive summer hiking trails.
